Toggle.Name: Toggle GM Screen
Toggle.Hint: Open or close the GM screen.

Rules.MissingCompendium: Couldn't find this content in the PF2e system's compendiums. Is the PF2e system up to date?
Rules.ConditionsHint: Hover for a summary, click to read, drag onto a token, sheet or Party row to apply. X = has a value.

Degrees.criticalSuccessRule: Meet or beat the DC by 10 or more.
Degrees.criticalFailureRule: Fall short of the DC by 10 or more.
Degrees.natural: A natural 20 improves the result by one degree; a natural 1 worsens it by one degree.

Dying.knockedOut: At 0 HP you're unconscious with dying 1 (dying 2 from a critical hit or a critically failed save), plus your wounded value.
Dying.recovery: Recovery check at the start of your turn: flat check DC 10 + dying value. Crit success −2 dying, success −1, failure +1, crit failure +2.
Dying.death: You die at dying 4, reduced by your doomed value.
Dying.wounded: Losing the dying condition gives wounded 1, or increases wounded by 1.
Dying.heroPoints: Hero points: spend 1 to reroll a check. Spend all (at least 1) when you would die to lose dying and stay at 0 HP without increasing wounded.

Environment.standardCoverRule: +2 to AC, Reflex saves against area effects, and Stealth to Hide, Sneak or Avoid Notice. Take Cover to make it greater.
Environment.greaterCoverRule: +4 to the same checks as standard cover.
Environment.terrainRule: Difficult terrain costs +5 feet per square; greater difficult terrain costs +10 feet. You can't Step into difficult terrain.
Environment.lightRule: In dim light, creatures without low-light vision see others as concealed. In darkness, creatures without darkvision can't see.
Environment.fallingRule: Take bludgeoning damage equal to half the distance fallen, and land prone. Falling into water or another soft surface reduces the effective distance.

RecallKnowledge.dc: DC = the creature's level DC, adjusted for rarity (uncommon hard, rare very hard, unique incredibly hard).

Party.RosterHint: Drop a condition or effect on a row to apply it. Click a condition to lower it (Shift-click removes it). Shift-click HP buttons for ±10.
Party.Empty: No characters to show. Create a Party actor, or pick characters under "Who's Shown".
Party.NoCandidates: There are no player-owned characters in this world yet.
Party.NoToken: {name} has no token on the current scene.
Party.SecretHint: Rolls the check for every character as a blind GM roll; players don't see the results.

Source.override: Showing only the characters ticked below.
Source.partyActor: Showing the Party actor's characters. Tick characters below to choose them yourself.
Source.playerOwned: Showing every player-owned character. Tick characters below to choose them yourself.

Treasure.ByLevelHint: Treasure for a party of four over a whole level (GM Core). Item counts are "how many × item level".
Treasure.CurrencyShare: Of that, {currency} gp should be currency (adjusted for party size).
Treasure.InvalidEntry: Enter a description and a value above 0 gp.

Storage.world: Saved in this world (no Party actor found).

Treasure.LootHint: Pick filters and roll to draw random items from the PF2e equipment compendium.
Treasure.NoPartyActor: There's no Party actor in this world to hold a stash.
Treasure.CoinsHint: Each PC gets an equal share in gp/sp/cp; anything that doesn't divide evenly goes to the Party stash. Both buttons log the coins to the budget.
Treasure.Split: Each of {count} PCs got {share}. Left over: {remainder}.
